rules: Only change a feature's passes value. Never edit or delete descriptions or test steps; record corrections in claude-progress.txt.
passes true requires every test step verified.
Features with needs_owner_approval need Lawrence's approval before code.
'Staging or local' means https://develop--studiopulse-staging.netlify.app or a local app on a non-production Convex backend. Never test writes against production.

features.description: A developer can install dependencies cleanly from the lockfile.
test_steps: Check out a branch based on origin/develop
Run `npm ci` and expect exit code 0
Run `git status --short` and expect no changed tracked files

features.description: The whole app type-checks.
test_steps: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and expect exit code 0 with no errors

features.description: The full unit and integration test suite passes, including the three failures recorded as known on main.
test_steps: Run `npx vitest run` and expect 0 failed tests
Specifically expect convex/lib/agentScope.test.ts, convex/marketing/results.test.ts and the live-call case in convex/outreachCalls.test.ts to pass

features.description: Lint passes with no errors.
test_steps: Run `npm run lint` and expect 0 errors (the 2026-11-12 record was 53 errors, 111 warnings)

features.description: The production web build compiles.
test_steps: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL to a non-production deployment
Run `npx next build` (skips the codegen prebuild) and expect exit code 0

features.description: A developer can run the app locally against a non-production backend.
test_steps: Provide a non-production NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL in the environment or .env.local
Run `./init.sh` and expect it to start or reuse the dev server and report /pricing 200
Open http://localhost:3147/dashboard and expect seeded studio data, with no request to pastel-corgi-340
